$comment: Per-event hook budgets for scripts/hook-bench.mjs, in units of one bare Node start on the measuring machine, so they hold across machines. `events` is the regression gate, set about 25% above the 2026-10-10 measurement (after the git memo and if filters); a change that exceeds one must explain why. `target` is where the event should land once hook calls no longer start Node per call (decision record H3); lower `events` toward it as work lands.
